title: AirLLM++ Super-Block Sequential Packing, Offset-Indexed Plans & Depth-Pipelined Prefetch Runtime
author: ontology-spider-and-rea-learning-wave

edges.description: howardleegeek/airllm-plus at commit 2a9f04035d80abf43fe7579673d08947c49080f1; surfaced via Ontology-Spider dependency edge bench->runtime and REA .pyc inspection
Batches single-layer reads from AirLLM into multi-layer contiguous blocks with producer-consumer prefetch queues

claims.assertion: pack_blocks.py groups per-layer tensor shards (.safetensors/.bin/.pt/.onnx) into contiguous multi-layer super-blocks (default layers_per_block=4) recorded with TensorMeta byte offsets/sizes in index.json so runtime/store.py performs sequential reads or O(1) f.seek(offset)/f.read(size) range reads.

runtime/executor.py coordinates Plan (create_plan), BufferedBlockStore, depth-bounded producer-consumer Prefetcher (queue.Queue(maxsize=depth) daemon worker), and thread-safe OrderedDict BlockCache enforcing both max_blocks and max_size_bytes eviction.
runtime/cache.py implements thread-safe OrderedDict LRU block eviction bounded simultaneously by entry count and total byte size, skipping oversized entries cleanly.

distilled_learning: Replace fragmented per-layer disk reads with contiguous super-block packing indexed by (file, offset, bytes), and overlap I/O with execution using a depth-bounded producer-consumer prefetcher plus count-and-byte-capped LRU cache.
